name: leadflow-ai
description: LeadFlow AI — agentic lead qualification & appointment booking (FastAPI + LangGraph + React)

scripts.setup: uv sync --directory apps/api && npm --prefix apps/web install
scripts.start: npm run build && uv run --directory apps/api leadflow-api
scripts.test: uv run --directory apps/api pytest -q && npm --prefix apps/web run typecheck
scripts.lint: uv run --directory apps/api ruff check src tests
